import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec2, vec4 } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, Color } = ctx.THREE;

  const group = new Group();

  // Resolve Spec Colors
  const colors = config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors ?? {
    ink: '#16161d',
    paper: '#e8ecf2',
    accent: '#ff2a38',
    surface: '#0b0b10'
  };

  // 1. STAGE: Engineered backdrop gradient stage to anchor composition and prevent flat black void
  const backdropGeo = new PlaneGeometry(7.5, 6.0);
  const backdropMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true, depthWrite: false });
  
  const backdropColorBottom = new Color(colors.surface);
  const backdropColorTop = new Color(colors.ink).multiplyScalar(0.5);
  const vUv = uv();
  
  backdropMat.colorNode = vec4(
    vUv.y.mix(backdropColorBottom, backdropColorTop),
    1.0
  );
  
  const backdropMesh = new Mesh(backdropGeo, backdropMat);
  backdropMesh.position.set(0, 0, -2.5);
  group.add(backdropMesh);

  // 2. HERO SPRITE (Journal Card Plane)
  // Aspect ratio calculation: 512 / 320 = 1.6
  const width = 3.2;
  const height = width / 1.6;
  const cardGeo = new PlaneGeometry(width, height);
  const cardMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true });

  const cardMesh = new Mesh(cardGeo, cardMat);
  group.add(cardMesh);

  // Dynamic Texture Loading
  const imageUrl = config.imageUrl ?? '/prism-assets/chrome/ceramic-grain.map.png';
  ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(imageUrl).then((tex) => {
    // Atlas safe UV mapping for 0, 0, 512, 320 inside potential 512x512 texture allocation
    const vUvs = uv();
    // 320/512 = 0.625 ratio adjustment for height mapping
    const atlasUv = vec2(vUvs.x, vUvs.y.mul(0.625));
    cardMat.map = tex;
    cardMat.map.uvNode = atlasUv;
    cardMat.needsUpdate = true;
  });

  // 3. MOTION & ANIMATION (Weighted Settle Entrance)
  const timeline = gsap.timeline({});
  
  timeline.fromTo(
    cardMesh.position,
    { y: -0.4 },
    { y: 0, duration: 0.8, ease: 'power3.out' }
  );
  
  timeline.fromTo(
    cardMesh.scale,
    { x: 0.95, y: 0.95, z: 0.95 },
    { x: 1.0, y: 1.0, z: 1.0, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power4.out' },
    '<'
  );

  // 4. CLEANUP HANDLER
  group.userData = {
    cleanup() {
      backdropGeo.dispose();
      backdropMat.dispose();
      cardGeo.dispose();
      cardMat.dispose();
      timeline.kill();
    }
  };

  return group;
}
